## Course description

MATE 374 develops numerical modeling skills through materials-engineering questions. Students formulate models, select computational methods, verify numerical results, and interpret predictions with appropriate units and limitations.

## Provisional learning emphasis

- model geometry, physical reasoning, verification, and interpretation;
- numerical concepts and method selection;
- only the coding mechanics needed to make work reproducible.
